layerChain.why: These modules may import each other only in this direction. career.ts imports them; none of them import career.ts. If you need something from career.ts in one of them, move it down instead.

forbid.reason: The engine is pure rules. It must work with no screens.
The engine must not depend on React.
Rules do not know about accounts or the cloud.

gotchas.title: The engine owns the facts
gotchas.text: The model only tells the story and may propose small effects that the engine clamps. Every feature has to work with no model at all.

gotchas.title: New random numbers shift every seeded test
gotchas.text: Anything that consumes the RNG changes every seeded result after it. When a test that used to pass starts failing, suspect this first and make the test robust (more seeds, or pin the thing it depends on). Do not weaken the feature.

gotchas.title: A new field on GameState needs three things
gotchas.text: A .default(...) in the schema so old saves load, a value in createCareer (the type has no optional fields), and a line in the 'older saves' test. A rename or reshape needs a migration instead.

gotchas.title: Flags only hold simple values
gotchas.text: story.flags takes strings, numbers and booleans. Difficulty, challenge tags and the documentary storyline all live there. Absent means the old behaviour, so older saves are unchanged.

gotchas.title: Standard difficulty must change nothing
gotchas.text: Normal multiplies by 1 and consumes no randomness, so a save plays exactly as it always did.

gotchas.title: UI changes go through mutate()
gotchas.text: The store clones the save, applies a change and autosaves. Engine functions mutate a draft in place; the screens never edit state directly.

gotchas.title: Coaching reuses the pro league
gotchas.text: Coach seasons run through simOtherGames and set career.teamId to the coached team. Do not call advanceWeek in coaching: it is built around the player.

gotchas.title: Statistical guards need many seeds
gotchas.text: A single seeded sample can land well either side of the average. The scoring-concentration and balance guards measure several seeds for that reason.

gotchas.title: UI tests mock the store hook
gotchas.text: Server rendering reads a store's initial snapshot, so screen tests replace the hook with one that reads live state. Copy the pattern from screens.test.ts.

gotchas.title: Internal names still say hoops-legacy
gotchas.text: The package, desktop appId and the IndexedDB database name were not renamed with the product. Changing them would orphan saves and break auto-update.

gotchas.title: Windows quirks
gotchas.text: Source files use CRLF line endings, so hand-rolled scripts must normalize before matching. Shell heredocs containing $ or template strings can be blocked by a safety check; write the script with an editor tool and run it with node.

gotchas.title: Everything the game writes must be plain
gotchas.text: A test (plainAudit) fails if any life event, choice result, profile or message reads as metaphor or mood-setting. Write what happened and what it means. Run it with AUDIT=1 to see the lines.

gotchas.title: Character text and behaviour is gated by profile
gotchas.text: Events use isProfile / isProfileOrLegacy. A person with an empty profile is from before profiles existed and keeps the old behaviour, so do not gate by profile alone without thinking about them.

gotchas.title: Athletes can vanish at level changes
gotchas.text: enterLevel deletes every non-persistent athlete that is not carried up. Anyone the story is built on has to be carried or retired on purpose, or they disappear from the league.
